# Jubilees Chapter 41 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 41:2 — reason for Er's hatred of Tamar

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "for she was not from the daughters of Canaan" | Follows Ge'ez literally — Er wanted a Canaanite wife |
| LOGOS | "for she was not one of the daughters of Canaan" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "because she wasn't Canaanite like his other relations" | Expands with "other relations" not in text |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS. The Ge'ez says Er hated Tamar because she was not Canaanite — this is ironic given the intermarriage prohibition in ch.30. PNEUMA's expansion adds detail not in the source.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 41:9 — "harlot" vs. "prostitute" vs. "cult prostitute"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "harlot" | Traditional; avoids qedeshah vs. zonah distinction |
| LOGOS | "prostitute" | Modern equivalent |
| PNEUMA | "prostitute" | Same |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "prostitute." In Genesis 38, the text uses both zonah (prostitute) and qedeshah (consecrated woman), but the Jubilees Ge'ez uses a single term throughout. EMET's "harlot" is archaic; "prostitute" is clearer. Note: project convention in Genesis 38 preserves "consecrated woman" for qedeshah — but Jubilees uses only one term.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 41:18 — "more righteous than I"

All three translators agreed on this exact rendering. It is a key verse and the project consensus was immediate.

**Status:** No disagreement.

---
